idea.value: A future-night party wall: guests should leave believing 2050 can be beautiful and is already half here.

subject.value: Scenes from 18 films and shorts about the world around 2050 (see Projection 2050 artifact).

medium.value: Existing film footage, projected silently to the host's own playlist

platform.value: Projector on a wall, 16:9, mostly 2.39:1 sources letterboxed

method.value: Curated cuts from legal copies; YouTube clips only to preview and locate scenes
